name: Chang'e 7
location_str: Pad 101 @ Wenchang Space Launch Site, CHN
slot_a_text: The 'pogo oscillation' is a dangerous vibration caused by fuel surging in the pipes, which can shake a rocket to pieces.
slot_b_text: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation's 42nd launch of the year, 612th all time. 2nd from 101 this year, 74 days since the last one. The 201st orbital launch attempt worldwide this year.
description: Chang'e 7/CE-7 is scheduled to launch in 2026, including an orbiter, a lander, a mini-hopping probe, and a rover. The mission will land in the South Pole regions of the Moon to study lunar surface environment around the South Pole, especially in looking for water ice in lunar soil.
rocket_fact: The 'pogo oscillation' is a dangerous vibration caused by fuel surging in the pipes, which can shake a rocket to pieces.
